title: Top Gun and Alien actor Tom Skerritt dies at 93
title_zh: 《壮志凌云》《异形》演员汤姆·斯凯里特去世，享年93岁

image.credit: Photo by Teo Zac on Unsplash
image.author: Teo Zac

lead: Tom Skerritt, the American actor who appeared in Top Gun and Alien, has died at the age of 93. His family said he died of natural causes, and they remembered his kindness and humour.
lead_zh: 曾出演《壮志凌云》和《异形》的美国演员汤姆·斯凯里特去世，享年93岁。他的家人表示他死于自然原因，并回忆了他的善良与幽默。
preview: Skerritt worked as an actor for about 60 years, and he appeared in many famous films. His family said in a statement that the world knew him
preview_zh: 斯凯里特的演员生涯长达约60年，出演过许多著名电影。他的家人在声明中说，世人因他出色的职业生涯而认识他，而家人记住的是他的温暖与爱。
paragraphs: Skerritt worked as an actor for about 60 years, and he appeared in many famous films. His family said in a statement that the world knew him for his great career, although they knew him for his warmth and love.
He was born in Detroit in 1933 and served in the US Air Force before he became an actor. His first film was War Hunt in 1962, and he later played a doctor in the comedy MASH.
He starred with Sigourney Weaver in Alien in 1979, and he played Viper in Top Gun in 1986. He also won an Emmy Award in 1993 for the TV drama Picket Fences.
Skerritt helped start a film school in Seattle because he believed stories can help people heal. He is survived by his wife Julie, five children and several grandchildren.
paragraphs_zh: 斯凯里特的演员生涯长达约60年，出演过许多著名电影。他的家人在声明中说，世人因他出色的职业生涯而认识他，而家人记住的是他的温暖与爱。
他1933年出生于底特律，在成为演员之前曾在美国空军服役。他的第一部电影是1962年的《战争狩猎》，后来他在喜剧《陆军野战医院》中饰演一名医生。
1979年，他与西格妮·韦弗合作出演《异形》；1986年，他在《壮志凌云》中饰演“毒蛇”。1993年，他还凭电视剧《警戒围栏》获得艾美奖。
斯凯里特帮助在西雅图创办了一所电影学校，因为他相信故事能帮助人们疗愈。他身后留下妻子朱莉、五个孩子和几个孙辈。

He starred with Sigourney Weaver in Alien in 1979, and he played Viper in Top Gun in 1986. He also won an Emmy Award in 1993 for the TV drama Picket Fences.

Skerritt helped start a film school in Seattle because he believed stories can help people heal. He is survived by his wife Julie, five children and several grandchildren.
